report.summary: The provided slice (daedalus/spine/cancel.py) only covers process-tree cancellation. No code for external API calls is present, so it is impossible to determine which stop mechanism (if any) interrupts an in-flight API call, or what half-written state results when either fires.
risks: Incomplete context masked ability to assess API-call interruption guarantees
todos: Obtain the relevant code slices for killswitch and API call handling (e.g., CancelToken) to perform the requested analysis.
